Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the recorded daily maximum air temperature at a standard London weather observing station (such as London Heathrow, London City, or St. James's Park) exceeds 19°C at any point strictly after 2026-10-02T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-03T23:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if the recorded daily maximum air temperature at a standard London weather observing station does not exceed 19°C throughout the window strictly after 2026-10-02T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-03T23:00:00Z.

Clarifications:
- "Topping 19°C" means a recorded temperature strictly greater than 19.0°C; exactly 19.0°C does not satisfy the condition.
